{
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py",
      "line": 80,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "OptimizedCursorPaginator cannot paginate datetime fields",
      "body": "OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint now allows OptimizedCursorPaginator with order_by=\"-datetime\". That paginator is a copy of the numeric Paginator: get_item_key does math.floor/math.ceil on the attribute, and value_from_cursor returns the raw cursor number. AuditLogEntry.datetime is a datetime, so after fetching rows build_cursor calls math.floor(datetime) and raises TypeError; if a numeric cursor value is provided, build_queryset also compares a timestamp column to a number, causing a SQL operator error. The optimized audit-log pagination path is therefore broken for admins."
    },
    {
      "file": "src/sentry/api/paginator.py",
      "line": 882,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Negative offset slicing on Django QuerySet raises ValueError",
      "body": "OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result takes the enable_advanced_features branch when cursor.offset < 0 and slices queryset[cursor.offset:stop]. Django QuerySets do not support negative slicing; this raises ValueError: Negative indexing is not supported. The audit log endpoint enables this flag, and cursor offsets are user-controlled strings parsed by Cursor.from_string, so a request with a negative cursor offset will produce a 500 instead of paginating."
    },
    {
      "file": "src/sentry/spans/buffer.py",
      "line": 197,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "data",
      "title": "Buffer storage changes from Redis set to sorted set without migration",
      "body": "process_spans now executes ZADD against span-buf:s:*, and _load_segment_data/add-buffer.lua now use ZSCAN/ZCARD/ZUNIONSTORE. The previous version stored these keys as Redis sets with SADD/SUNIONSTORE. During a rolling deploy, keys written by the old code before the deploy still have type set; the first ZADD or ZCARD on those keys returns WRONGTYPE, failing span processing and causing retries until the old keys expire. There is no migration, key-format versioning, or cleanup for existing set-typed keys."
    },
    {
      "file": "src/sentry/scripts/spans/add-buffer.lua",
      "line": 63,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "data",
      "title": "Eviction can remove the segment root span producing invalid segments",
      "body": "After merging, the script does zpopmin(set_key, span_count - 1000) to keep only 1000 spans. The lowest score is the oldest end_timestamp_precise, and the segment/root span is frequently the oldest member. If the root span is popped, the remaining set can contain child spans whose parent_span_id/segment_id refers to the removed root, but no span with span_id == segment_key; the flush path then emits a segment with segment_id set and no is_segment=True span. This silently corrupts/incompletes the segment. The cap is also hardcoded to 1000 while SpansBuffer.max_segment_spans defaults to 1001 and is now unused, so configuration cannot control this behavior."
    },
    {
      "file": "tests/sentry/spans/test_buffer.py",
      "line": 157,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "test_gap",
      "title": "No tests cover insertion-time eviction or sorted-set migration",
      "body": "The tests were updated to pass end_timestamp_precise, but no test exercises the new sorted-set eviction path: inserting >1000 spans, verifying the cap is applied, checking that the root span is not evicted, or verifying that old set-typed keys are migrated/handled. Given the data-integrity risks in this change, this behavior should be covered."
    }
  ]
}

findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator cannot paginate datetime fields
findings.body: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint now allows OptimizedCursorPaginator with order_by="-datetime". That paginator is a copy of the numeric Paginator: get_item_key does math.floor/math.ceil on the attribute, and value_from_cursor returns the raw cursor number. AuditLogEntry.datetime is a datetime, so after fetching rows build_cursor calls math.floor(datetime) and raises TypeError; if a numeric cursor value is provided, build_queryset also compares a timestamp column to a number, causing a SQL operator error. The optimized audit-log pagination path is therefore broken for admins.

findings.title: Negative offset slicing on Django QuerySet raises ValueError
findings.body: OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result takes the enable_advanced_features branch when cursor.offset < 0 and slices queryset[cursor.offset:stop]. Django QuerySets do not support negative slicing; this raises ValueError: Negative indexing is not supported. The audit log endpoint enables this flag, and cursor offsets are user-controlled strings parsed by Cursor.from_string, so a request with a negative cursor offset will produce a 500 instead of paginating.

findings.title: Buffer storage changes from Redis set to sorted set without migration
findings.body: process_spans now executes ZADD against span-buf:s:*, and _load_segment_data/add-buffer.lua now use ZSCAN/ZCARD/ZUNIONSTORE. The previous version stored these keys as Redis sets with SADD/SUNIONSTORE. During a rolling deploy, keys written by the old code before the deploy still have type set; the first ZADD or ZCARD on those keys returns WRONGTYPE, failing span processing and causing retries until the old keys expire. There is no migration, key-format versioning, or cleanup for existing set-typed keys.

findings.title: Eviction can remove the segment root span producing invalid segments
findings.body: After merging, the script does zpopmin(set_key, span_count - 1000) to keep only 1000 spans. The lowest score is the oldest end_timestamp_precise, and the segment/root span is frequently the oldest member. If the root span is popped, the remaining set can contain child spans whose parent_span_id/segment_id refers to the removed root, but no span with span_id == segment_key; the flush path then emits a segment with segment_id set and no is_segment=True span. This silently corrupts/incompletes the segment. The cap is also hardcoded to 1000 while SpansBuffer.max_segment_spans defaults to 1001 and is now unused, so configuration cannot control this behavior.

findings.title: No tests cover insertion-time eviction or sorted-set migration
findings.body: The tests were updated to pass end_timestamp_precise, but no test exercises the new sorted-set eviction path: inserting >1000 spans, verifying the cap is applied, checking that the root span is not evicted, or verifying that old set-typed keys are migrated/handled. Given the data-integrity risks in this change, this behavior should be covered.
